# CA certificates that the container image must not trust, one SHA-256
# fingerprint per line, as `openssl x509 -fingerprint -sha256` prints it.
# check-ca-bundle.sh reads this file. Blank lines and lines that start with
# `#` are ignored.
#
# The three emSign roots below match the removals in NSS 3.131.1. They
# issued the eMudhra intermediates whose private keys are public
# (CVE-2026-111943). emSign Root CA - G1 stays trusted, as it does in NSS.

# emSign ECC Root CA - G3
86:A1:EC:BA:08:9C:4A:8D:3B:BE:27:34:C6:12:BA:34:1D:81:3E:04:3C:F9:E8:A8:62:CD:5C:57:A3:6B:BE:6B
# emSign Root CA - C1
12:56:09:AA:30:1D:A0:A2:49:B9:7A:82:39:CB:6A:34:21:6F:44:DC:AC:9F:39:54:B1:42:92:F2:E8:C8:60:8F
# emSign ECC Root CA - C3
BC:4D:80:9B:15:18:9D:78:DB:3E:1D:8C:F4:F9:72:6A:79:5D:A1:64:3C:A5:F1:35:8E:1D:DB:0E:DC:0D:7E:B3
